skins.label: Funk Groove
skins.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production SQUARE illustration atlas for an existing Colt Radio music-player skin. This is illustrated background/character artwork; real buttons and text will be HTML/CSS. Exact THREE-REGION layout: TOP y=0–33% is a detailed wide scenic HEADER with NO horse, no people, no text, dark clear central title area; MIDDLE y=33–53% is a blank themed material panel with beautifully decorated narrow vertical side rails at x=0–7% and 93–100%, center dark clear and uncluttered; BOTTOM y=53–100% contains exactly ONE friendly equine Colt head-and-shoulders portrait facing RIGHT in a confident three-quarter pose, centered around x=50%, full ears/mane/hat entirely visible with breathing room, head starts below y=55%, shoulders extend to bottom edge, character occupies x=22–78%. Clean horizontal boundaries between all three regions. Horse must have a long anatomically equine muzzle, expressive eyes, natural horse ears and mane, no human face, no human hands. Premium richly painted game-interface illustration, beautifully detailed materials, vivid balanced lighting, proportional anatomy and school-appropriate personality. No text, letters, numerals, watermarks, music-note symbols, baked buttons, station cards, UI labels, or extra horses anywhere. The portrait should be readable when cropped into a small player portrait. Keep the same THREE-REGION SQUARE atlas proportions, do not make a finished UI screenshot. THEME FUNK GROOVE: TOP is a fabulous 1970s funk recording stage with burnt-orange velvet, plum acoustic walls, warm amber spotlights, copper speaker grilles, orange shag trim, a funky electric BASS guitar on far left and a vintage clavinet/analog keyboard on far right, curving groovy architectural motifs and a few vinyl records at outer corners. MIDDLE is deep PLUM amp grille fabric with copper borders and narrow burnt-orange amplifier side rails, beautifully tactile knobs along only far edges. BOTTOM: deep COCOA-BROWN horse with warm copper highlights, a natural voluminous rounded CURLY BLACK mane between visible horse ears, amber-tinted round aviator glasses, confident friendly closed-mouth smile, flamboyant orange/cream/plum geometric-pattern 1970s open-collar stage shirt, plum velvet vest with copper piping and a small tasteful gold chain. Horse coat remains brown, not orange or purple. Distinctive funk musician personality, not a DJ and no headphones. Bottom background dark plum. Palette burnt orange, plum, copper and warm cream.
